ro.a: Case splendide cu cadre de lemn și fațade placate cu șist.

en.q: What was the Imperial Palace of Goslar?
en.a: A significant palatine complex where many imperial diets were held in the Middle Ages.

en.q: What was mined at Rammelsberg?
en.a: Primarily silver, copper, lead, and zinc for over 1000 years.

en.q: What is special about the marketplace of Goslar?
en.a: The historic town hall and the glockenspiel with figures depicting mining history.

en.q: What architectural style can be seen in Goslar's old town?
en.a: Magnificent half-timbered houses and facades clad in slate.

de.a: In der Senne bei Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock in Nordrhein-Westfalen.
Eine weltbekannte Werft in Papenburg an der Ems, die riesige Kreuzfahrtschiffe baut.

de.q: Wie gelangen die Kreuzfahrtschiffe zum Meer?
de.a: Sie werden bei der sogenannten 'Emsüberführung' rückwärts den Fluss hinunter zum Meer bugsiert.

de.q: Welche Landschaften prägen den Lauf der Ems?
de.a: Das Emsland und Ostfriesland mit vielen Wiesen und Kanälen.

hu.a: Az észak-rajna-vesztfáliai Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock közelében, a Senne-ben.
Egy világhírű hajógyár az Ems menti Papenburgban, ahol hatalmas óceánjárókat építenek.

hu.q: Hogyan jutnak el az óceánjárók a tengerhez?
hu.a: Az úgynevezett 'Ems-átvezetés' során hátrafelé vontatják le őket a folyón a tengerig.

hu.q: Milyen tájak jellemzik az Ems folyását?
hu.a: Az Emsland és Kelet-Frízföld, sok réttel és csatornával.

ro.a: În Senne lângă Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock în Renania de Nord-Westfalia.
Un șantier naval de renume mondial în Papenburg pe Ems, care construiește nave de croazieră uriașe.

ro.q: Cum ajung navele de croazieră la mare?
ro.a: Ele sunt tractate cu spatele pe râu până la mare în cadrul așa-numitei 'transferări pe Ems'.

ro.q: Ce peisaje caracterizează cursul râului Ems?
ro.a: Regiunea Emsland și Frizia de Est, cu multe pajiști și canale.

en.q: Where does the Ems originate?
en.a: In the Senne near Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock in North Rhine-Westphalia.

en.q: What is the Meyer Werft?
en.a: A world-famous shipyard in Papenburg on the Ems that builds huge cruise ships.

en.q: How do the cruise ships get to the sea?
en.a: They are towed backward down the river to the sea during the so-called 'Ems conveyance'.

en.q: What landscapes characterize the course of the Ems?
en.a: The Emsland and East Frisia with many meadows and canals.
